# shoehorn_marketplace_items (Data Source)

Retrieves available items from the Shoehorn marketplace catalog.

## Example Usage

```terraform
# List verified marketplace items
data "shoehorn_marketplace_items" "all" {}

output "verified_items" {
  value = [
    for i in data.shoehorn_marketplace_items.all.items : i.slug if i.verified
  ]
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Optional

- `category` (String) Filter items by category.
- `kind` (String) Filter items by kind.

### Read-Only

- `items` (Attributes List) The list of marketplace items. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--items))

<a id="nestedatt--items"></a>
### Nested Schema for `items`

Read-Only:

- `author_name` (String) The author of the marketplace item.
- `category` (String) The category of the marketplace item.
- `description` (String) The description of the marketplace item.
- `featured` (Boolean) Whether the marketplace item is featured.
- `kind` (String) The kind of marketplace item.
- `name` (String) The display name of the marketplace item.
- `slug` (String) The unique slug of the marketplace item.
- `tier` (String) The tier of the marketplace item (free, premium, enterprise).
- `verified` (Boolean) Whether the marketplace item is verified.
- `version` (String) The current version of the marketplace item.
